answer: Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. The wander is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the zenith. What survives to the relic is a record of labour, not a list of addresses.
